project_title: AI Patient Symptom Triage & Clinical Intake Platform
project_description: We operate 14 outpatient clinics and experience severe front-desk triage bottlenecks. We need an AI diagnostic triage assistant that captures structured patient symptoms before arrival, classifies urgency tiers, integrates with our PostgreSQL EHR records, and routes high-risk cases to a physician Human-in-the-Loop dashboard for immediate sign-off.
business_objectives: Reduce patient intake wait times by 50%; ensure 100% physician oversight on high-risk triage classifications; maintain 99.9% clinical system availability.
additional_requirements: Strict PHI data encryption, role-based access control for doctors vs. receptionists, and full audit trails.

project_title: Smart Multi-Property Tenant & Predictive Rent Portal
project_description: We manage 1,200 rental units across 18 apartment buildings using manual spreadsheets and scattered WhatsApp chats. We want a centralized property and tenant management platform similar to TenantEase with digital tenant ID verification, unit vacancy tracking, automated monthly rent reminders, and predictive late-payment risk alerts.
business_objectives: Eliminate manual rent tracking spreadsheets; achieve 98%+ on-time rent collection; provide real-time occupancy and revenue dashboards for property owners.
additional_requirements: Automated payment receipt generation, tenant maintenance ticket triage, and historical payment audit logs.

project_title: High-Concurrency Live Event Ticketing & AI Concierge
project_description: During major concert drops, our current ticketing website crashes when more than 5,000 users join simultaneously. We need a cloud-native ticketing architecture capable of handling 50,000+ concurrent users with zero latency flicker, distributed Redis seat-lock queues, and an AI support agent for instant booking inquiries.
business_objectives: Support 50,000+ simultaneous ticket buyers without downtime; prevent double-booking via atomic seat locks; automate 80% of fan support queries.
additional_requirements: Kubernetes auto-scaling, cross-border payment gateway integration, and anti-bot queue protection.

project_title: Multi-Branch AI Reputation & Crisis Escalation Engine
project_description: We manage 35 retail and dental branches receiving over 2,500 Google and Instagram reviews monthly. We need an AI reputation management platform like Revio that syncs reviews across platforms, performs aspect-based sentiment analysis per branch, drafts brand-safe responses, and triggers immediate crisis alerts for manager approval.
business_objectives: Centralize reputation monitoring across all 35 branches; reduce review response time to under 2 hours; detect branch-level operational defects early.
additional_requirements: Role-based hierarchy for Global Admins, Brand Managers, and Branch Advisors.
